== Course of events ==

In the pool where Alice had newly made the Mouse's acquaintance, a conversation unfolds between the two. Alice, in her innocent discourse, speaks of dogs—a topic that wounds the Mouse's sensibilities and causes offense. Yet from this moment of discomfort springs an unexpected proposition: the Mouse promises to share his history with Alice, should they succeed in reaching the shore. This conditional offer becomes a thin thread of connection between them, binding their fates together through a story yet untold.
